summary: Verified Sales tab (Balance -> Sales) bug fix and new PDF/Excel export feature in offline React app. All acceptance criteria met.

verification_details.bug_fix_credit_sales_excluded: PASS - SalesReport.jsx only iterates salesData (props). creditData prop removed from parent ZAPTRStyleCalculator.jsx line 3949-3953. Note text on UI reads 'Data comes from Reading Sales only (credit sales are tracked separately in Credit Manage)'.
verification_details.table_columns: PASS - Date + per-fuel (Total Litre/Testing/Net) + MPP (Total/Test/Net) columns rendered correctly for CNG, Diesel, Petrol, Premium
verification_details.caption: PASS - 'Sales From 01 Jul 2026 to 23 Jul 2026' visible above 2-column button grid

critical_code_review_comments: SalesReport.jsx handles PDF/Excel via jsPDF+jspdf-autotable and xlsx correctly. Try/catch with toast fallback is in place.

Minor observation: seed data with unexpected sales shape (missing fields) crashed elsewhere in ZAPTRStyleCalculator with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading toFixed)'. This is NOT in SalesReport (which uses parseFloat || 0 defensively). It occurs in other consumers of salesData that assume required fields; consider adding defensive parsing site-wide. Not a regression from this change and out of scope for the current bug fix.
ZAPTRStyleCalculator.jsx is 4191 lines — recommend splitting into smaller modules for maintainability (code-review guideline: files >700 lines).
seed_data_creation: Injected sales+credit localStorage entries to attempt cross-verification, then cleared. Final verification used empty state which correctly shows 'No sales data in selected date range'.
